one_line: One uncut top-down shot with a send-to-a-named-person text promising a concrete gain, 10 minutes.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static top-down: a whisk packed with colourful pom-poms on a white counter, a child's hand resting at the left, an adult hand at the whisk handle. No speech. Text, centred: "תשלחי את זה לאמא שצריכה 10 דקות".
q1_hook.why: The text speaks to one person, a tired mother, and promises a concrete gain, 10 minutes, so it is a send prompt from the first frame (H1, T3, R5). The colourful object is eye-catching (H1). No voice or face opens it (against H4), so the hook has no sound side (H6).

beats.what: Whisk full of pom-poms; a small hand rests, then pushes one in; text over the middle
beats.why: A bright object, a named recipient and a gain

beats.what: A child's hand brings one pom-pom at a time from the edge and pushes it through the wires
beats.why: Repeating action; each colour is a small new moment

beats.what: Both hands work, a pink pom-pom waits outside the frame; the whisk is nearly full
beats.why: The Reel stops mid-activity, with no payoff

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen throughout: "תשלחי את זה לאמא שצריכה 10 דקות" (a send ask). Caption: "10 דקות של שקט בבית". No comment or save ask.
q2_flow.why: The hook text is a ready-made reason to send (R5, C4), and the small steady action is calming to watch. But 26 s of one action with no new beat after the first 3 s is a dry stretch (R3, R1), and there is no payoff or end (R4).

q3_cta.what: On screen from 0:00 to the end: "תשלחי את זה לאמא שצריכה 10 דקות". Not said (no speech). The caption has no ask and ends with a safety line, "כמובן בהשגחה בלבד".
q3_cta.why: A send ask with a named recipient, a mother who needs a break, and a stated reason, 10 minutes: the best shape for sends (C4, R5), and the only ask (C1). It is up from the first frame, before any value (against C6), and not said aloud.

q4_shown.what: A whisk filling with colourful pom-poms on a white counter; a child's hand and forearm push one pom-pom at a time through the wires; an adult hand steadies the whisk. No face, brand or price; it ends with a nearly full whisk.
q4_shown.why: The activity is its own proof: one object, one action, a child absorbed for 26 s, so a parent can picture doing it (S4). No child's face or reaction is shown (against K8), which suits S5, but it leaves no emotional centre.

q5_edit.what: One continuous static top-down shot of 26 s, no cuts, no speed change. One text box on screen for the whole Reel, about 47 to 53 percent down. No speech. It ends mid-action with a pink pom-pom waiting outside the frame.
q5_edit.why: Constant small motion keeps a single shot alive, but 26 s with no cut or new beat after 3 s is the dry-stretch pattern (R3, R1, E2). The text covers the middle of the whisk throughout (T2). It stops with no payoff (R4, E8).

q6_topic.what: A simple sensory activity for a young child, pushing pom-poms into a whisk; the need is 10 quiet minutes for a tired parent.
q6_topic.why: A real parent need, a break, named in the hook (K6), with a tip made from items at home that is easy to send or save (R5, R7). The caption adds a safety line and modest benefits (K4). The mood is calm, not high arousal (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A static top-down view of a white marble counter, phone propped, bright even light; a child's hand and forearm enter from the top and right edges with their shadow; an adult hand steadies the whisk at the bottom. No face.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down over a clean counter gives a bright, sharp frame where the colours stand out (F5, F7). A propped phone and one take is the simplest shoot (H8, E6). The whisk fills only the lower-left and the text sits across its centre (F4, T4).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00 to the end, one white bold sans-serif text box, two lines, centred about 47 to 53 percent down, "10" in bolder type: "תשלחי את זה לאמא שצריכה 10 דקות". It sits over the whisk throughout. No labels or subtitles.
q8_text.caption: "פעילות חושית פשוטה לקטנים וגדולים 🌈". About 30 words in 6 short lines: three skills (fine motor, focus, calm), "והבונוס האמיתי? 10 דקות של שקט בבית", a safety line, then 3 hashtags (#טיפיםלהורים #משחקיםלילדים #עשהזאתבעצמך). No ask, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The text is short, readable, names a person and a clear gain (T3, T5), and stays all 26 s, so it works muted (T1). But it sits over the centre of the picture (T2). The caption opens with the activity in searchable words and adds a safety note (T7, K4).

weak_points: 26 s of the same action with no new beat; the text covers the whisk; no payoff or end; no voice; the only ask comes before any value; a child's hand with no reaction.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one uncut top-down shot of hands turning the book's pages under a line like "send this to a mom who wants...". 10 to 15 s.
not_verified: Who the creator is and whether the hand is her child's; the child's age; music (the transcript is only "תודה רבה", so there is no speech); any brand relationship. No corrections to the first pass.
